column1: # Per-table overrides for churn_columns.sh (meaningful-content hashing).
# The auto rules already exclude date/time columns, integer id / *_id columns and
# a sole integer primary key, so most churning tables need no entry here
# (e.g. ui.term_phenotype_display -> tpd_id, created_at are auto-excluded).
# Add a line only when the auto rules get a table wrong:
#   <schema.table>  exclude  col1,col2   # churn the auto rules miss (e.g. a text load id)
#   <schema.table>  include  col1        # a meaningful integer *_id the rules would drop
# Changing a table's entry changes its excluded set, so reports comparing a
# snapshot taken before the change with one taken after show real churn as n/a
# for that table until both sides use the same set.
# Integer FKs into parents whose ids are stable -- a change here is a real re-pointing.
# foreign_db is a static lookup table.
public.sequence_feature_chromosome_location_generated  include  sfclg_fdb_db_id
# psg_id / pg_id were stabilized by ZFIN-10350 (incremental natural-key apply).
public.pheno_term_fast_search       include  ptfs_psg_id
public.genotype_figure_fast_search  include  gffs_psg_id,gffs_pg_id
# expression_result2 is curated, not regenerated, so xpatres_pk_id is stable.
public.expression_term_fast_search  include  etfs_xpatres_pk_id
# Sole integer PK that is a natural key, not a surrogate: the NCBI Gene ID.
public.entrez_gene  include  eg_acc_num
